headline: CORPORAL PUNISHMENT. US PUBLIC SCHOOLS. 2021-22.
sub: Students: 24,534. States where it is legal: 17. States where it is used: 15. Boys: 81 percent. Black students: 26 percent of those struck, 15 percent of enrollment.
fact: Source: US Department of Education, Civil Rights Data Collection, published January 2025.

headline: 36 of 38 OECD countries ban hitting kids in school.
sub: The two that don't: the United States, and one Australian state.
fact: Global Initiative to End All Corporal Punishment of Children, March 2025.
